title: Frobenius involution canonicalizer
group_model: F42 affine maps x -> a*x + b over Z7; involutions are x -> -x + b

canonical_choice.reason: BT1444 fixed Szilassi face has index 4

interpretation: The unique involution fixing the Szilassi closure face supplies a convention-free ordering seed for Otto strands and Fano flags, modulo local direction labels.
